defect_found.symptom: Full logs listed 3 of the 7 operations an answer paid for, named the model on one step only, and showed no usage at all on a reopened conversation.
defect_found.root_cause: The UI read only the node events it knew by name, and the usage block the API returned was not stored with the turn, so saved replay had nothing to return.
defect_found.fix: PR 116 (merged f3dc5298): the chat paths compute the usage block once, store it with the turn and return the same object; saved replay returns it; Full logs lists every usage node with its model under a 'Cost by operation' total that matches.
defect_found.tests: backend tests/backend/test_session_scope.py 19 OK (6 new, all red on the old code); frontend 858/858, tsc clean
defect_found.production: frontend release.txt f3dc5298; API nl2sql-agent:217 COMPLETED. Live answer: 7 operations, 7,216 tokens, about $0.0094; reopened conversation: 7 operations, 14.71 s, 7,803 tokens, about $0.0037 (screenshots in the session).

release_build_registry.problem: CodeBuild's anonymous Docker Hub pull of python:3.11-slim returned 429. PR 117 (3b22cc1) moved the base image to AWS's public mirror, claiming it had no anonymous limit; that was wrong: the mirror returned 429 to GitHub's runners twice (public standalone-product run 40284657424, verify job).
release_build_registry.fix: PR 118 (merged 57a417e): backend/Dockerfile takes ARG PYTHON_IMAGE (default Docker Hub, which serves GitHub's runners); deploy/codebuild/api-buildspec.yml logs in to ECR Public and passes the mirror image, so each builder pulls from the registry that serves it. IAM inline policy nl2sql-agent-build-ecr-public-login added to the CodeBuild role. The CodeBuild project now reads deploy/codebuild/api-buildspec.yml instead of an inline buildspec.
release_build_registry.proof: build nl2sql-agent-build:9a557b7b SUCCEEDED from origin/main 57a417e using deploy/codebuild/api-buildspec.yml (log: ecr-public login, FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.11-slim); API nl2sql-agent:218 COMPLETED; live answer 844 December 2025 orders, 7 operations, 7,424/241 tokens, $0.003253, cost_complete true.
